entities.name: Centaur
entities.description: A species with equine bodies and human torsos, known as archers, heavy cavalry and druids, found on many planes.

entities.name: Windseeker Centaurs
entities.description: Centaurs of the Green Lands of southern Aerona, mercenaries and superlative fighters.

entities.name: Helki
entities.description: A Windseeker centaur who convinced his tribe to join Gull's army.

entities.name: Holleb
entities.description: A Windseeker centaur who convinced his tribe to join Gull's army.

entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: A spellshaper served by many Jamuraan centaurs.

entities.name: Krosan centaurs
entities.description: Warriors and druids of the forest of Krosa in Otaria.

entities.name: Lagonna Band
entities.description: Somewhat civilized Theran centaurs who are mostly merchants.

entities.name: Pheres Band
entities.description: Primal, savage Theran centaurs roaming between Akros and Setessa.

entities.name: Iroas
entities.description: God of Victory, depicted as a centaur with the lower half of a bull.

entities.name: Heidar
entities.description: A cryomancer whose snow-magic empowered some reindeer-centaurs.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: City-plane where centaurs associate with the Selesnya Conclave and Gruul Clans.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: Plane home to the Lagonna and Pheres Bands.

events.summary: Helki and Holleb return to their people and convince all 50 Windseeker tribe members to join Gull's wizard-hunting army.
events.quote: After returning to their people in 4074 AR , Helki and Holleb were able to convince all 50 members of their tribe to join Gull 's wizard -hunting army.

events.summary: The centaurs of Argoth, allies of elves and druids, perish with them before the Brothers' War.
events.quote: the centaurs of Argoth were important allies of the elves and human druids of the island and perished with them.
